The '''Aro'ruul''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur's]] [[Cupric Islands]]. They lived in herds, had [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long quills, and released a "growth-catalyzing" pheromone when at peace.<ref name="LoNH" />
